note: Phase 9 ownership manifest for keyboard contract, clipboard and bulk-edit behaviors, Notes, Indicators, Parties, Assessments, Task Requests, Decisions, coordination surfaces, optional standardized surfaces, and remaining analyst-work workbook surfaces. Sprint 1 through Sprint 8 direct rows declare claim_status=implemented where complete. Sprint 9 owns the final Phase 9 gate and handoff.

ledger.title: Phase 9 Coverage Ledger
notes: Sprint 0 activates Phase 9 as a selectable harness phase using explicit blocker sentinels; Sprint 1 replaces keyboard dispatch, grid-anchor, and keyboard browser rows with direct evidence.

Every authoritative Phase 9 row has exactly one declared execution dependency from the approved evidence layers: backend_unit, backend_store, backend_integration, frontend_unit, or browser_functional.
Sprint 1 row-level evidence can be green while aggregate Phase 9 targets remain red from later-row blockers or pending final-gate work; that status does not complete broader Phase 9.
Sprint 8 closes artifact-backed variant registry evidence and exposes standardized Findings, Investigative Queries, and Forensic Keywords rows as additive workbook-native system views.

Sprint 2 clipboard and bulk-edit evidence is split by ownership: shared ingest planning is backend-unit evidence, persistence/provenance is backend-integration evidence, rendered dispatch is frontend-unit evidence, and visible workbook behavior is browser-functional evidence.
Timeline and tabular-ingest clipboard helper tests are support evidence only; the authoritative U-9-02 owner remains the workbook shared paste and bulk planning unit row.
Clipboard paste evidence remains distinct from file-based CSV/XLSX import and Import Extension Profile evidence.
Sprint 7 replaces the coordination-surface blocker with direct backend-store, backend-integration, and browser-functional evidence for Communications Log, Handoff, Status Review, and Lesson.
Sprint 8 optional standardized surface evidence applies while Findings, Investigative Queries, and Forensic Keywords remain exposed through base discovery and workbook selector exposure.
authoritative_execution: `backend-unit` selects direct Sprint 2 shared tabular-ingest planning evidence for clipboard paste, direct Sprint 5 timestamp_instant_v1 evidence, and Sprint 8 artifact-backed variant registry closure evidence.

`backend-store` selects direct Sprint 3 Notes and Indicators evidence, direct Sprint 4 Party exact-match and direct-reference evidence, direct Sprint 5 Assessment evidence, Sprint 6 Task and Decision evidence, direct Sprint 7 coordination evidence, and Sprint 8 optional standardized surface behavior evidence.

`backend-integration` selects direct Sprint 2 clipboard persistence, entity-origin paste, bulk-mutation evidence, Sprint 5 Assessment projection-backed query evidence, Sprint 6 Task and Decision projection evidence, and Sprint 7 coordination projection evidence.
`frontend-unit` selects direct Sprint 1 keyboard command/grid-anchor evidence plus Sprint 2 rendered paste-dispatch anchor evidence.

`browser-e2e-webserver-backed` selects direct Sprint 1 keyboard evidence, Sprint 2 visible clipboard paste evidence, Sprint 5 assessment workflow evidence, Sprint 6 Task and Decision workflow evidence, Sprint 7 coordination workflow evidence, Sprint 8 required registry identity evidence, Sprint 8 optional standardized surface workflow evidence, and shared-grid browser evidence.
support_execution_extras: Phase 4 workbook generic, assessment, Party, Indicator, and coordination smoke evidence remains support-only substrate and cannot claim Phase 9 completion or satisfy Phase 9 row ownership by itself.
Phase 6 grid, collaboration, pending-queue, and conflict marker evidence remains support-only substrate and cannot claim Phase 9 keyboard, clipboard, or shared-grid completion.
Phase 8 query, saved-view, grouping, sorting, filtering, and startup evidence remains support-only substrate and cannot claim Phase 9 workbook behavior.
Phase 9 timeline clipboard and tabular-ingest helper tests remain support-only substrate and cannot claim U-9-02 by themselves.
Support-only carryover files are listed in forbidden_id_files so they cannot accidentally claim Phase 9 identifiers.
shared_harness: | Active manifest ownership | `tools/phase9_test_map.json` records every authoritative guide row and marks earlier phase carryover as non-owning support. |
| Blocker sentinel boundary | Sprint 0 sentinels were selectable only to prevent false completion claims; replaced sentinels are no longer behavior evidence. |
| Generated ledger | `docs/testing/phase9_coverage_ledger.md` is generated from this manifest and must not be hand-edited. |
| Schedule boundary | Phase 9 is active because coherent selectable row symbols and titles exist; Sprint 9 owns the final phase gate and handoff. |
support_only: Existing Phase 4 backend, frontend, and browser evidence for Parties, Indicators, Assessments, coordination, and generic workbook routes remains previous-phase support only.
Existing Phase 6 backend, frontend, and browser evidence for collaboration, conflict, presence, pending queue, and grid marker behavior remains previous-phase support only.

Existing Phase 8 backend, frontend, and browser evidence for query controls, saved views, sorting, filtering, grouping, startup selection, and projection-backed query semantics remains previous-phase support only.
Replaced Phase 9 Sprint 0 sentinels are not implemented behavior and are no longer authoritative row evidence.

unit.claim: Communications Log, Handoff, Status Review, and Lesson persist as workbook-native artifact rows with distinct artifact_type values, enforce minimum create signals before defaults, leave no partial durable state on store and route rejected creates, emit no record_changed event for rejected route creates, keep saved views additive to canonical view_schema_id surfaces, generate immutable subtype IDs, apply omitted defaults, derive handoff.ack_state from acknowledged_at, sort handoff.ack_state by the canonical pending-before-acknowledged token order, validate coordination record_ref, party_ref, and handoff-scoped risk_ref collection actions against same-incident active targets, preserve comm_log.audience text while supplemental party refs change, keep risk refs as scoped handoff child rows, prove exact collection item wire shapes and duplicate coalescing for every Sprint 7 coordination collection field, and query projection-backed sort, semantic filter, and group fields declared for all four coordination surfaces.

unit.claim: Findings, Investigative Queries, and Forensic Keywords are exposed as additive current-build workbook surfaces with the exact optional view_schema_id resources, artifact_grid_projection source filters, and owner-defined field sets; cartulary.view.hypotheses.v1 remains absent; workbook-native backend behavior creates rows only after declared minimum signals, applies defaults, rejects invalid writes without partial durable state, mutates Findings lifecycle and references through structured state, queries projection-backed filters/sorts/groups for all three surfaces, and derives finding.confidence_band at the Core 02 unset/low/medium/high boundaries.

unit.claim: timestamp_instant_v1 accepts RFC 3339 JSON strings with Z or numeric offsets, normalizes offset-equivalent values to one UTC instant for equality and idempotency hashing, clears only timestamp fields declared clearable=true including coordination next-report and acknowledged-at fields, rejects explicit null for non-clearable coordination timestamp_utc fields, and fails closed for empty strings, whitespace-padded strings, timezone-less strings, date-only strings, numbers, booleans, arrays, and objects in workbook mutation and timestamp query operand decoding.
unit.out_of_scope: Visible invalid timestamp draft preservation is claimed by E-9-05 rather than this backend-unit row.

unit.claim: Direct Party- and Decision-reference writes accept only exact stable identifiers, reject non-direct or non-exact lexical shapes including whitespace-padded IDs, labels, emails, and non-scalars, preserve direct value=null clear semantics, and fail closed for foreign-incident, deleted, wrong-type, or deployment-user UUID targets without mutating the referencing row.
unit.out_of_scope: Collection review relationships, Decision supersession, and non-reference Task/Decision workflow behavior are covered by their own rows.

unit.claim: Assessment support_refs, Task linked_record_ids, Decision support_refs, Decision affected_record_ids, and all coordination record_ref, party_ref, and risk_ref collection fields reject client-supplied confidence in collection-action payloads; manual record and party links created or preserved through those fields persist provenance='manual' with authoritative confidence=NULL, while handoff risk refs remain child rows without generic record-link confidence.
